div.head: II Cn 61
div.ab: [G]if hwa on fyrde gryðbryce fulwyrce, ðolige lifes oððe weregildes.
Gif hwa on fyrde griðbrice fulwyrce, þolige lifes oððe wæregildes.
Si quis in exercitu (regis) pacis infractionem perficiat, uitam perdat uel weregildo redimat.
Griðbryce. Gyf hwa on fyrde griðbryce fulwyrce, ðolie liues oððon weregyldes.
Gif hwa on fyrde gryðbryce fulwyrce, ðolige lifes oððe weregildes.
(Bruch des Sonderfriedens. B) Wenn einer in der Landwehr Bruch des Sonderfriedens voll[schwer, durch Todtschlag] verübt, verliere er Leben oder [sein] Wergeld.
(Breach of special peace. B) If anyone commits a full[-weight] breach of special peace [by homicide] in the army, let him lose life or [his] wergild.
Breach of the peace. If anyone is guilty of a capital deed of violence while serving in the army, he shall lose his life or his wergeld.
If anyone commits a full breach of the peace in the army, he is to forfeit his life or his wergild.
If anyone commits a capital crime while serving in the army, he shall lose either his life or his wergild.
